purpose: Close the outstanding 9-Mar Central-Pacific K706 action after the 705th G4M element has been debited from the Indian-Ocean ledger.
historical_anchor: K-706 is reported to have executed a successful long-range night raid on the Eniwetok base on 9 Mar without loss.

adjudication.US_effect: minor airfield/parking-area disruption; 1-3 aircraft destroyed/damaged centered across parked/staging aircraft, light personnel/material casualties, no runway mission-kill beyond the local night/next-morning repair cycle

strategic_effect: Confirms that surviving Japanese land-based aviation can still impose nuisance/attrition pressure at long range. It does not reverse Eniwetok operationalization and does not justify exposing the carrier cadre in a search battle.
